label: SYNTHETIC — every paste, name, phone (5550 block or 0000-style placeholders) and address is invented; no real person
note: Held-out evaluation set, independent of the tuning set (dev) and the bench. 15 order pastes, each scored on form A and on form C (30 items), plus 15 booking pastes on form B: 45 items. Traps: two dates where only one is the check-in, relative dates (today = Sunday 2026-11-22, so 'this Friday' = 2026-11-27 and 'next Monday' = 2026-11-30), year-less dates (next occurrence on or after today, today included), number words, quantity glued to item (3pcs, 2x), RT/RW address parts (kept inside the street line when they sit in the copied address line), forwarded From:/To: header blocks, injected instruction lines, two phones (the one the message says to use, else empty), missing fields. Conventions follow dev.json: honorifics dropped, unit words that are part of the item kept (pair of, sets of), province empty unless written, form-A notes carry delivery instructions including a service phrase, form-C svc is set only when the paste says so and rmks then omits the service phrase. Authorship: one model-writing pass (Claude Sonnet 5.5), blind to any bench output; a second blind pass will re-check gold before the file is hashed. Second blind pass (qa-judgment, pastes+gold only): 45 items checked, 0 wrong, 4 ambiguous groups kept as authored: H08/HB13/H12 two phones with no stated preference (gold empty; the first/mobile number is defensible) and H02-C svc 'Express if you can' (gold EXP).
